name: Orange-Hoisin Chicken Salad with Cabbage, Bell Pepper & Tortilla Chips

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 red bell peppers
6 oranges

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with stir-fry and hoisin sauces. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup stir-fry sauce
3 tbsp hoisin sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl along with the shredded cabbage.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Crush tortilla chips into small pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
